title: Registry Discovery Contract Tolerance And Rust Twin Collapse
description: W0 mechanism-preparation sub-ticket under the Crate Consolidation & Plugin Taxonomy Restructure master (26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE). Scope: make the plugin registry TS script and the repo-cli Rust twin tolerant of the future new plugin layout (packages/rust/Cargo.toml with role=plugin metadata + taxonomy tree) while the current 7-crate constitutional layout still exists and must keep passing (LEGACY_LAYOUT_TOLERANT). Add a warn-only validateTaxonomyTree for plugins discovered via the new contract. Parameterize discoverExamplesForPlayground and validatePlaygroundSessions off structural facts instead of hardcoded literals. Collapse the Rust twin (framework/products/repo/modules/cli rust lib.rs): delete the Cargo.toml scanner/parser/emitter duplication, keep only load_playground_catalog reading the generated JSON + a reduced check_registry, keep the TUI table rewired to the loaded catalog. No crates move in this wave. Files owned exclusively: 🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🔌️plugin/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript/📇️registry/📜️script.ts and 🧰️framework/🛍️products/🦑️repo/🔨️modules/⌨️cli/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs.
summary:
W0 mechanism-prep for the crate-consolidation restructure. Task 1 (registry script.ts): added LEGACY_LAYOUT_TOLERANT=true discovery branch matching the new packages/rust/Cargo.toml contract (role=plugin ignored/role=framework filtered the same way non-plugin crates already are); added warn-only validateTaxonomyTree + findNewContractPluginRoots (no-op today, zero migrated plugins); de-hardcoded discoverExamplesForPlayground's apps-dirname literal and validateConstitutionalCrates's apps-dirname literal into one shared APPS_DIRNAME constant; rewrote validatePlaygroundSessions to assert structural shape (resolveRegistryPluginIdsForFilter/resolveRegistryPluginIdForFilter/total registry count) instead of hardcoded plugin-id strings and a magic ">10" threshold. Verified `generate` then `check` still pass and the 6 generated files are byte-identical to before (git diff on generated/ is empty) — purely additive/dormant since no packages/rust dir exists yet.

Task 2 (repo-cli lib.rs): deleted the ~440-line Cargo.toml scanner/parser/emitter (find_plugin_cargo_files, parse_plugin_cargo_text, parse_playgrounds_text, parse_assets_text, discover_examples_for_playground, generate_plugin_registry, generate_playground_registry, validate_playground_registry, emit_plugins_json/ts, emit_playgrounds_json/ts, write_registry, plus the TomlScan helpers) and the PluginRegistryEntry struct — confirmed via repo-wide rg that nothing outside this crate/file called any of them. Kept load_playground_catalog and Ports/PlaygroundEntry/AssetSpec. Fixed check_registry's generated_dir, which pointed at a non-existent legacy ASCII path (`framework/plugin/registry/generated`) — a pre-existing dead-code bug now surfaced by making check_registry load-bearing; it now points at the real emoji path and is reduced to "the two generated JSON files exist and parse". plugin_registry_command::run's "generate" subcommand now forwards to `bun nx run @semio-tech/plugin-registry:generate` instead of reimplementing generation. Added playgrounds_json_text (raw passthrough of the generated JSON) to replace the deleted emit_playgrounds_json for `semio catalog --json`. Removed the 6 tests that exercised deleted parse/validate functions; added 4 new tests covering check_registry (missing files, invalid JSON, valid pass) and playgrounds_json_text (missing-file fallback, passthrough). TUI dashboard already read from load_playground_catalog, not the scanner, so it needed no rewiring.

Verification: `bun …/registry/script.ts generate` then `check` — pass, catalog unchanged (36 plugins, 58 playgrounds). `cargo check -p semio-framework-repo-cli` — clean. `cargo test -p semio-framework-repo-cli` — 11/11 pass. `cargo check -p semio-framework-os-run --bins` (the run bin that include!s the generated 🦀️artifacts.rs) — clean (pre-existing unrelated warnings only). `cargo check -p semio-framework-os-renderer-wgpu` — 3 pre-existing compile errors (HostEffect/dsl_core/request_media_frames) unrelated to the generated registry files (no hosts.rs/artifacts.rs/PLUGIN_HOST/PLUGIN_WASM mentioned in the errors); confirmed this file is concurrently staged-modified by another session (git status shows it `M ` before I touched anything, no diff of mine touches it) — not caused by this ticket, out of scope to fix. `bun ./📜️script.ts verify gate` — got through dependency-cruiser, plugin-registry:check (green — my code), region/host-contract lints, check-no-px, then blocked on an unrelated pre-existing step ("framework-core ts-rs binding freshness") failing with `ENOENT: posix_spawn 'cargo'` even after an nx daemon restart and with sandbox disabled — an environment/PATH issue in a completely different crate's ts-rs binding check, not touched by this ticket.
